name: Standard
notes: The adaptable baseline. No specialization and no ceiling.
old_trait: Choose two additional Focus Skills at creation instead of one trait. Once per session, treat any one Skill as a Focus Skill for a single roll.
flags: Trait to be decided (Origins no longer give Focus Skills).

name: Stoneborn
trait: See in any light short of total darkness. Once per scene, sense the shape and soundness of worked stone or raw earth you are touching.
notes: Thick-boned mountain folk. Slow, immovable, and hard to surprise underground.

name: Forgeborn
trait: Choose your substrate at creation; it sets one resistance and one vulnerability. DR 1 against Physical damage. Immune to Poisoned, Burning, and temperature Exhaustion. Needs maintenance rather than food or sleep.
notes: Constructed rather than born. Metal, wood, stone, mineral, circuitry, or any combination — including a fully artificial mind.

choice.name: Substrate
choice.text: Sets one resistance and one vulnerability.

name: Skyborn
trait: Glide from any height without falling damage, covering 1 range band horizontally per band descended. Once per scene, hold a hostile creature’s gaze — it loses its next Reaction.
notes: Tall, hollow-boned, feathered along the arms. Cannot carry heavy loads well.

name: Drakeblood
trait: Resist one Effect type chosen at creation (Fire, Cold, Electric, or Acid) — its damage is halved. Once per scene, exhale that Effect at Close range as an attack.
notes: Scaled and heavy-jawed. Ancestral fire runs closer to the surface than thought does.

name: Sylvan
trait: See in any light short of total darkness. Once per scene, the GM tells you one true thing about the natural environment you are standing in.
notes: Thin, wiry, and long-lived. Sharp senses paid for with a slighter frame.

name: Feolin
trait: See in total darkness to Near range. Never suffer falling damage from two range bands or less. Sensitive to loud noise — Deafened DCs against you are 2 lower.
notes: Feline and quick, with reflexes that fire before judgment does.

name: Smallfolk
trait: Never suffer penalties for cramped or confined spaces. Once per session, reroll any one failed roll and take the second result.
notes: Small, nimble, and famously difficult to discourage.

name: Greenskin
trait: See in any light short of total darkness. +2 to Stealth in crowded, cluttered, or underground environments.
notes: Wiry scavengers built for tight spaces and quick exits.

name: Giantborn
trait: Count as one size larger for lifting, carrying, and grappling. Natural hide grants DR 1 against Physical damage.
notes: Massive and thick-skinned. The world arrives slowly and is dealt with directly.

name: Ironhide
trait: See in any light short of total darkness. Once per session, when reduced to Broken, remain standing with 1 box unmarked instead.
notes: Built to absorb punishment. Even tempers are harder to come by than tough skin.

name: Verdant
trait: Need no food while you spend an hour in sunlight each day. Once per session, root in place — you cannot move, but gain DR 2 and immunity to Prone until you uproot. Fire Effects deal +2 to you.
notes: Bark-skinned and slow-growing. Patient in a way that unsettles people.

name: Deepkin
trait: Breathe water as easily as air. Immune to pressure and to Exhausted from cold. Moving through water costs nothing; moving across dry ground in heat costs 1 extra Action per range band.
notes: Pale, smooth-skinned, and built for depth. Relentless the way water is.

name: Crystalline
trait: Your body refracts. Once per scene, split an incoming Effect — halve its damage and redirect the other half to one adjacent target. Sonic Effects deal +2 to you.
notes: Grown rather than born. A conduit for things that need one.

name: Mycelian
trait: Once per scene, touch a living thing and learn one true fact it knows. Immune to Poisoned and to all disease. Radiant Effects deal +2 to you.
notes: Part of something larger that thinks slowly and remembers everything.

name: Highborn
trait: Start at Reputation 2. Once per session, invoke your family name for access or favorable terms without a roll.
notes: Raised to command and never taught to endure.

name: Edgeblood
trait: Once per scene, ask one yes/no question about your immediate environment. The GM answers truthfully. Not usable in combat.
notes: Something in the bloodline notices too much and belongs nowhere.

name: Wyldkin
trait: Communicate basic intent with natural animals. Ignore difficult terrain in natural environments.
notes: Raised closer to the treeline than the hearth.

name: Voidtouched
trait: Spend 1 Mana to detect supernatural presence at Near range. A Natural 1 on any Cast triggers Minor Fallout regardless of Surge level.
notes: Something reached back. It has not entirely let go.

name: Augmented
trait: Choose a package at creation — Optical (+1 Observe), Neural (+1 Tactics), Skeletal (+1 Endure), or Combat (+1 to one Combat skill). Vulnerable to EMP effects.
notes: Improved on purpose, at a cost paid somewhere quieter.

name: Psionically Emergent
trait: Once per encounter, spend 1 Mana for a free Observe check at Near range reading surface emotion.
notes: The talent arrived unasked and has not finished arriving.

name: Street Survivor
trait: Never flat-footed in urban environments. Once per session, find a useful mundane item anywhere a settlement exists.
notes: Learned in doorways and alleys. Faith was never on offer.

name: Corporate Asset
trait: Begin each session with one corporate favor — a resource, a contact, or a piece of information. It creates an obligation the GM may invoke later.
notes: Owned in a way that shows on no paperwork you have seen.

name: Haunted
trait: Once per session the GM whispers a one-sentence omen. Fear check DCs against supernatural sources are reduced by 2.
notes: Accompanied. Whether it means well has never been established.

name: Bloodline
trait: The GM defines one setting-specific trait — narratively significant, mechanically minor, and carrying at least one complication.
notes: Descended from something the setting has a name for.
